items.title: Drift hack recovery opened near one cent per dollar lost
items.whyYouShouldCare: The recovery of funds from the Drift hack could restore confidence in Solana's security, impacting its liquidity and user trust.

items.title: Ondo liquidity spreads across chains – Solana leads, Ethereum’s share drops to 52%
items.whyYouShouldCare: Solana's increasing share of Ondo liquidity indicates growing cross-chain activity, which may enhance its ecosystem usage and market position.

items.title: Crypto job postings triple to over 1,200 in September, but applications fall
items.whyYouShouldCare: The surge in crypto job postings suggests a potential growth in the industry, but declining applications could signal challenges in attracting talent to Solana's ecosystem.
